```{r}
#| include: false
setup_file <- if (file.exists("_report_setup.R")) "_report_setup.R" else file.path("report", "code", "_report_setup.R")
source(setup_file)
package_status <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "r_package_status.tsv"))
function_contract <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "package_function_contract.tsv"))
validation_summary <- read_if_exists(file.path(plan$paths$results_dir, "validation_summary.tsv"))
decision_log <- read_if_exists("config/decision_log.tsv")
```
